modules.title: Architecture and threat model
modules.activation: Architecture and trust boundaries are always relevant to assessment planning.

modules.title: Identity, authorization and sessions
modules.activation: Authentication, user roles, accounts, tenant boundaries, or their presence is unknown.

modules.title: Sensitive data and privacy
modules.activation: The system collects, stores, transports, exports or may expose customer or secret data.
inputs: storage, logging, retention and sharing paths

modules.title: Application code and input boundaries
modules.activation: Source, APIs, files, user input or external integrations cross a trust boundary.

modules.title: Business logic and concurrent integrity
modules.activation: Transactions, payments, entitlements, reservations or ordered workflows affect valuable state.

modules.title: Dependencies, secrets and supply chain
modules.activation: Packages, build tools, credentials, images or third-party components are used.

modules.title: Infrastructure and configuration
modules.activation: Host, network, cloud, container, database or storage controls are in scope.

modules.title: CI/CD and release verification
modules.activation: Build, release, deployment, environment separation or post-release checks are in scope.

modules.title: Deployed web and API assessment
modules.activation: A scoped web/API target and permission for the intended requests are available.
inputs: test accounts, request budgets and stop conditions

modules.title: Capacity, availability and recovery
modules.activation: Capacity, concurrency, recovery, incidents or operational readiness are in scope.
inputs: budgets, stop conditions and recovery objectives

modules.title: AI application and agent security
modules.activation: The target uses models, retrieval, tools, agent memory or model-driven actions.
inputs: data flows, permissions and action budgets
